map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.ch: Stone ninja hired by Sasori hold the road between the valley entrance and his town.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.ze: The White Zetsu spies try to melt into the trees, clutching their loot.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.seer.iruka: Iruka: "Naruto! White Zetsu spies are watching the outpost from the woods to the south, and they stole my Ichiraku Ramen Coupon. Get it back, and I'll give you something you've earned."
Iruka: "The Zetsu spies still have my coupon. They hide in the woods south of the outpost."
Iruka: "You got it back! Ramen is on me next time. And take my forehead protector: you're a real shinobi now."
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.ca: Orochimaru's Curse Mark warriors guard the cell where Kakashi is chained.
A Leaf sealing tag locks Kakashi's cell from outside: he sealed himself in to keep the Sound ninja from taking him away. Only Leaf chakra can release it.
The Leaf seal holds. Only a Leaf ninja can release it.
The seal knows your chakra and fades. Inside, something moves in the dark...
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.ambu: The ambush is beaten. The Sound ninja's packs hold gold and a map of the forest paths. Kakashi is just ahead.
Sound ninja were waiting inside the cell: an ambush!
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.ma: Manda rises, hissing, coiled around Orochimaru's snake contract. The great snake does not like visitors.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.seer.jirai: Jiraiya: "Off to fight the Akatsuki, are you? Then show me what you've got. Orochimaru's great snake Manda nests in the south-east of this forest and guards his snake contract. Bring me that contract, and you get the Fourth Hokage's cloak and two of my toads."
Jiraiya: "No contract yet? Manda keeps it in the south-east of the forest."
Jiraiya: "Ha! Not bad at all. That contract won't serve Orochimaru again. This was Minato's cloak. Wear it well, and take my toads with you."
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.ha: These Sound ninja raided a Leaf supply camp. One of them wears a Hokage Hat.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.hi: Sasori's human puppets drag Hiruko, his old shell, behind them.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.seer.chiyo: Chiyo: "Sasori is my grandson, and he has become a monster. His human puppets carry Hiruko, his old shell, in the south-east of the valley. Bring it to me, and I will teach you how to fight his puppets."
Chiyo: "Hiruko is still with Sasori's puppets in the south-east of the valley. If Sasori took it, take it from him."
Chiyo: "So this is what is left of his first puppet... Listen well: this is how Sasori fights."
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.ne: Kisame's Swordsmen of the Seven guard the First Hokage's Necklace, taken from a Leaf ninja.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.gate.barri: An Akatsuki barrier seals the way to the hideout. It gives way only to the Nine-Tails' chakra: Naruto himself must touch it, and he must be at least level 8.
The barrier holds. Only Naruto, at level 8 or higher, can break it.
Naruto's chakra flares up, and the barrier cracks open! Beyond it lies the Akatsuki hideout.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.hide: The Akatsuki hideout. In the cave below, the ritual has driven Shukaku mad. Deidara of the Akatsuki guards the way down.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.pandora.ga: A summoning scroll left by Jiraiya. Gamabunta, chief of the toads, answers your call!
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.de: Deidara and his clay clones block the way: "You want the One-Tail? Then let me show you true art. Art is an explosion!"
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.monster.sh: Shukaku, the One-Tail, tears free of the Akatsuki seals!
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.header.des:
The Akatsuki have stolen Shukaku, the One-Tail, from Sunagakure. Sasori holds Puppet Valley in the south, Kisame holds Shark Bay in the east, and in their hideout behind Shark Bay the extraction ritual has begun: in eight weeks it will be over. Tsunade sends Naruto from the Leaf Outpost. Kakashi went ahead to scout and has not come back. Free him, grow strong (the barrier gives way only to Naruto at level 8) and stop the ritual.

Win: defeat Shukaku. Lose: Naruto falls, or day 57 comes.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.tsun: A letter from Tsunade: "Naruto, the Akatsuki have stolen Shukaku, the One-Tail. Sasori holds Puppet Valley to the south, Kisame holds Shark Bay to the east, and their hideout lies behind Shark Bay, sealed by a barrier. Only your chakra can break it, and only once you are strong enough: level 8. The ritual will be over in eight weeks. Kakashi went ahead to scout and has gone silent. Beware Sasori: his valley lies just south of the outpost, behind the Sound ninja on the southern road. Keep a garrison in the outpost, and don't take Naruto south before his army is ready."
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.pakk: Pakkun, Kakashi's ninja dog, limps into the outpost: "Kakashi was ambushed by Orochimaru's Sound ninja. They keep him in the Forest of Death, east of here, in its north-east corner. Jiraiya is somewhere in that forest too."
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.chiy: A message from old Chiyo, the elder of Sunagakure: she hides from her grandson Sasori in a hut in the north-east of Puppet Valley and knows his weaknesses. Look for her once you are past the valley entrance.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.supp: Shizune sends supplies from Konoha: "Lady Tsunade says: spend them wisely."
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.scou: Scouts report: Sasori and Kisame have received reinforcements from the Akatsuki. Expect attacks on the outpost.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.mate: Tsunade sends rare materials from the Konoha storehouses.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.half: Four weeks are gone. The ritual is half done: Shukaku has four weeks left.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.event.last: Only one week left! After day 56 the Akatsuki will finish the ritual, and Shukaku will be lost.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.header.rum: They say Jiraiya, the Toad Sage, is peeping at the hot springs in the Forest of Death again.
Old Chiyo of Sunagakure has sworn to stop her grandson Sasori.
Kisame's Swordsmen of the Seven took a necklace from a Leaf ninja: the First Hokage's, they say.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.header.vic: Naruto has stopped the Akatsuki ritual.
Shukaku falls, and the Akatsuki ritual collapses. The One-Tail will go home to Sunagakure. Mission complete!
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.header.def: Naruto has fallen. Without him no one can break the Akatsuki barrier. The mission has failed.
The Akatsuki have finished the ritual.
Day 57: the Akatsuki have finished the ritual. Shukaku is lost, and the mission has failed.
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.header.vic: Defeat Shukaku in the Akatsuki hideout
map.naruto-shadow-of-akatsuki.header.def: Lose Naruto, or let day 57 come
